basic_info.main_problem: I feel confused about sexual orientation and identity, accompanied by feelings of inadequacy and fear of being rejected; these feelings began in adolescence and worsened after being rejected by a beloved person, persistently affecting learning, relationships and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Because fear of being rejected and identity confusion persistently affect daily functioning and physical and mental health, I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: Confusion about sexual orientation and identity began in adolescence; social expectations and worry about being unable to meet them brought high stress that has persisted long-term.
Confessing to a beloved girl was directly rejected; this event significantly worsened the fear of not being accepted and feelings of inadequacy.
Lives with parents, has long feared being rejected by parents, and is therefore more restrained and avoidant in intimate relationships and self-expression.
Once came out to a trusted friend and received non-judgmental support and acceptance; this experience of being accepted brought greater peace of mind and self-confidence.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved
The real me will not be accepted

special_situations.event: Directly rejected by the girl I like
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am Being rejected once, it means I am not worthy of being loved, and I will keep being Being rejected in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding closeness with people, reducing attempts to build intimate relationships
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My life is ruined; I will never be loved

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by fully meeting my parents' expectations will I be accepted; otherwise I will surely be Being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Conceals identity, avoids discussing related topics with parents

special_situations.event: Sees happy couples around or is reminded of romantic relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If everyone else has a partner and I do not, it means something is wrong with me and I will not be loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays away from social occasions and reduces contact with others to avoid comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not normal; I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Thinks about society's standards and expectations regarding sexual orientation and identity
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should meet society's standards, otherwise it proves I am not worthy of acceptance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-Repression, trying hard to meet external expectations to gain approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not be like this; I must meet their expectations

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be truly seen, loved, and accepted (including acceptance of sexual orientation and identity)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged and rejected by parents, the person I like, and society; worrying about being negated and losing belonging
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being Being rejected by avoiding intimacy and self-disclosure
Cater to outside expectations in exchange for safety and surface acceptance

object_relations.object_representation: Others with judgment and rejection tendencies (parents, society, the person one likes)

object_relations.self_representation: A self that can be seen and accepted

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about coming out to parents about sexual orientation or recalling being rejected by a crush
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see others as 'rejecters' who will judge and reject oneself (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a calm and empathic tone; first acknowledge the legitimacy of the Fear, then gently invite concrete evidence and counterexamples through Questioning, avoiding confrontation and labeling.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When intense Anxiety and physical discomfort (chest tightness, nausea) arise and more in-depth details and feelings are asked about
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to protect oneself by avoiding intimacy and self-exposure, reducing further touching on painful points
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lower the intensity of stimulation, use grounding and slow-paced inquiry, allow pauses and selective sharing, to enhance the sense of safety.

exception_events.target_problem: When expressing sexual orientation or identity to others, Lin Jiexi usually avoids sharing out of fear of being Being rejected, leading to Relationship estrangement and Anxiety worsened.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When coming out to a friend that time, the other person did not judge but gave support and acceptance; Lin Jiexi felt at ease and more confident about sharing identity further.
exception_events.reason: Different support: the friend was accepting and non-judgmental; different approach: choosing to express in a safe relationship; different situation: a private and more trustworthy communication setting.
